```python
import griffe

# Load the requests package using the module-level convenience function
package = griffe.load("requests")

# Get all public top-level functions
public_functions = [
    name for name, member in package.members.items()
    if not name.startswith("_") and member.is_function
]

# Print the names
for name in sorted(public_functions):
    print(name)
```
